{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check if any other revenue values are suspicious
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
print(f"Max revenue after cleaning: {sales['revenue_float'].max()}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}")

# Check the distribution of customer_segment
print("Customer segment distribution:")
print(sales['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of channel
print("Channel distribution:")
print(sales['channel'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of converted
print("Converted distribution:")
print(sales['converted'].value_counts())

# Check for -1 in customer_age
age_neg1_count = (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"Number of customers with age = -1: {age_neg1_count}")"}
